hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: folder_path
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
File path to the rawData folder
ex: s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/imaging_mesa_ecg/rawData/

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
### Assume ETL role aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds 900 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' \",') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' \",') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' \",')
# Create base directories mkdir -p "./${folder_path}/rawData/"
# Copy the processing script once aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/development_imaging/execute_xml_to_csv.py ./ --no-progress chmod +x execute_xml_to_csv.py
# Retrieve list of visit prefixes under rawData PREFIXES=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 \ --bucket avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl \ --prefix "${folder_path}/rawData/" \ --delimiter '/' \ --query "CommonPrefixes[].Prefix" \ --output text) || grep "Visit"
echo $PREFIXES
# Loop over each visit_name found for prefix in $PREFIXES; do
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds 900 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' \",') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' \",') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' \",')
visit=$(basename "$prefix") aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/$prefix ./${folder_path}/rawData/$visit --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.xml" --no-progress
# Convert XML to CSV python3 execute_xml_to_csv.py "./${folder_path}/rawData/" "$visit"
done
# Upload CSV results back to S3 recursively
aws s3 cp --recursive \ "./${folder_path}/rawData/" \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${folder_path}/rawData/" \ --exclude "*" --include "*.csv" --no-progress
